notes.title: Tank Core Demo Major Update - Demo Version 0.3 Patch Notes:
notes.notes:
1.Player


5 new turrets

5 new chassis

6 new shells

6 new modules

43 new cores

Adjusted many old components

Added an prop system with 5 basic props. Basic prop will spawn periodically during levels

Merged Level 1 & 2 turrets and chassis to strengthen early-game power

Shell slots are fixed at 2, toggled back and forth


2.Enemy


14 new enemies

3 new enemy supports

Adjusted some old enemies, mainly weakens enemies


3.Level


9 new terrains

1 new area

40+ new level

Adjusted many old levels

Levels no longer end immediately upon timeout, enemy bombers will spawn and attack

Added defense level, Survive until the timer runs out to win

Adjusted pass level reward

Store sells more things


4.Others


Adjusted many UIs, primarily on both sides of the levels, the refit factory UI, and the store UI

The level editor shows the map dimensions (width/height) and supports dynamic resizing

When viewing components, cleared turrets and chassis are marked with medal icons

Etc.
